막힘.답: With all her shortcomings, he still liked her.

막힘.답: He accused her of telling a lie.

막힘.까닭: '처벌받을 것을 두려워' → afraid of being punished(흔한 꼴) — 모범의 afraid 구문 지킴. 0점.

안적음.답: He escaped, afraid that he would be punished.
안적음.까닭: 기능어 that 하나 더 — 소유자 결정 2 로 70점.

시험.답: Having finished the homework, I had nothing to do.
Having finished the homework, I didn't have anything to do.
Having finished my homework, I had nothing to do.
Having done the homework, I had nothing to do.
Having completed the homework, I had nothing to do.
Since I had finished the homework, I had nothing to do.

막힘.답: Having finished the homework, I didn't have anything to do.
막힘.까닭: ㉱ 부정 꼴 not … anything(= nothing — 한국어 '아무것도 없었다' 의 곧은 꼴) — 완료 분사구문 지킴. 0점.

막힘.답: Having done the homework, I had nothing to do.
막힘.까닭: ㉮ '끝내다' → do(have done = 다 했다) — 완료 분사구문 지킴. 0점.

막힘.답: Having completed the homework, I had nothing to do.
막힘.까닭: ㉮ '끝내다' → complete — 0점.

안적음.답: Having finished my homework, I had nothing to do.
안적음.까닭: 한국어 '그 숙제' 의 '그' 를 my 로 바꿈 — 한정어 자리 기능어 하나 차이, 70점이면 됨.

안적음.답: Since I had finished the homework, I had nothing to do.
안적음.까닭: 이 문항이 가르치는 완료 분사구문(Having p.p.)을 since 절로 피함.

시험.답: Having finished the homework, I have nothing to do.
Having finished the homework, I don't have anything to do.
Having completed the homework, I have nothing to do.
Having done the homework, I have nothing to do.
As I have finished the homework, I have nothing to do.

막힘.답: Having finished the homework, I don't have anything to do.
막힘.까닭: ㉱ not … anything(= nothing) — 완료 분사구문 지킴. 0점.

막힘.답: Having completed the homework, I have nothing to do.
막힘.까닭: ㉮ '끝내다' → complete — 0점.

막힘.답: Having done the homework, I have nothing to do.
막힘.까닭: ㉮ '끝내다' → do — 0점.

안적음.답: As I have finished the homework, I have nothing to do.
안적음.까닭: 이 문항이 가르치는 완료 분사구문을 as 절로 피함.

시험.답: I know a student who studies very hard.
I know a student that studies very hard.
I know a student who studies really hard.
I know a very hardworking student.

막힘.답: I know a student that studies very hard.
막힘.까닭: 사람 선행사의 관계대명사 that(학교 문법이 who 와 함께 가르치는 맞는 꼴) — 관계절 지킴 · 뜻 같음. 70점.

막힘.답: I know a student who studies really hard.
막힘.까닭: ㉮ '매우' → really(흔한 강조) — 관계대명사 who 지킴. 0점.

안적음.답: I know a very hardworking student.
안적음.까닭: 이 문항이 가르치는 관계대명사 who 절을 형용사로 피함.

시험.답: I met a boy on the subway, who looked very happy.
I met a boy on the subway who looked very happy.
I met a boy on the subway, who seemed very happy.
I met a boy on the subway, who looked really happy.
I met a boy on the subway, and he looked very happy.

막힘.답: I met a boy on the subway, who seemed very happy.
막힘.까닭: ㉮ '(행복해) 보였다' → seemed(look 과 나란히 흔한 말) — 계속적 용법 who 지킴. 0점.

막힘.답: I met a boy on the subway, who looked really happy.
막힘.까닭: ㉮ '매우' → really — who 지킴. 0점.

안적음.답: I met a boy on the subway, and he looked very happy.
안적음.까닭: 이 문항이 가르치는 계속적 용법 who 를 and he 로 피함 — 70점이면 됨.

시험.답: I met her on Monday when there was a graduation ceremony.
I met her on Monday, when there was a graduation ceremony.
I met her on the Monday when there was a graduation ceremony.
I met her on Monday when a graduation ceremony was held.
I met her on Monday when there was a graduation.

막힘.답: I met her on Monday when a graduation ceremony was held.
막힘.까닭: '졸업식이 있었던' → a graduation ceremony was held(흔한 꼴) — 이 문항이 가르치는 관계부사 when 지킴 · 뜻 같음. 0점.

막힘.답: I met her on Monday when there was a graduation.
막힘.까닭: ㉮ '졸업식' → graduation(졸업식을 뜻하는 흔한 말) — when 지킴. 70점.

안적음.답: I met her on the Monday when there was a graduation ceremony.
안적음.까닭: 기능어 the 하나 더 — 소유자 결정 2 로 70점(제한 관계절 앞 the Monday 도 맞는 영어라 70점이면 됨).

시험.답: We walked along the beach at night, when it was cool and breezy.
We took a walk along the beach at night, when it was cool and breezy.
We strolled along the beach at night, when it was cool and breezy.
We walked along the beach at night, when the weather was cool and breezy.
We went for a walk along the beach at night, when it was cool and breezy.
We walked along the beach at night, and it was cool and breezy then.

막힘.답: We walked along the beach at night, when the weather was cool and breezy.
막힘.까닭: 한국어 '그때 날씨는' 을 곧게 옮긴 the weather — 계속적 용법 when 지킴 · 뜻 같음. 70점.

막힘.답: We took a walk along the beach at night, when it was cool and breezy.
막힘.까닭: ㉮ '산책했다' → took a walk(가장 곧은 번역) — when 지킴. 0점(길이 한도).

막힘.답: We went for a walk along the beach at night, when it was cool and breezy.
막힘.까닭: ㉮ '산책했다' → went for a walk — when 지킴. 0점.

막힘.답: We strolled along the beach at night, when it was cool and breezy.
막힘.까닭: ㉮ '산책하다' → stroll(사전 뜻) — when 지킴. 0점.

안적음.답: We walked along the beach at night, and it was cool and breezy then.
안적음.까닭: 이 문항이 가르치는 계속적 용법 when 을 and … then 으로 피함 — 70점이면 됨.

시험.답: We watched the movie at the theater in which there were many young couples.
We saw the movie at the theater in which there were many young couples.
We watched the film at the theatre in which there were many young couples.
We watched the movie in the theater in which there were many young couples.
We watched the movie at the theater in which there were a lot of young couples.
We watched the movie at the theater where there were many young couples.
We watched that movie at the theater in which there were many young couples.

막힘.답: We saw the movie at the theater in which there were many young couples.
막힘.까닭: ㉮ '(극장에서) 영화를 보다' → see a movie(watch 와 나란히 가장 흔한 짝) — 이 문항이 가르치는 in which 지킴. 0점.

막힘.답: We watched the movie at the theater in which there were a lot of young couples.
막힘.까닭: ㉮ '많은' → a lot of(명령서가 든 예) — in which 지킴. 70점.

막힘.답: We watched the film at the theatre in which there were many young couples.
막힘.까닭: 영국 영어 film(모범도 영국 표기 theatre) — in which 지킴. 0점.

막힘.답: We watched the movie in the theater in which there were many young couples.
막힘.까닭: '극장에서' → in the theater(at 과 나란히 흔한 전치사) — in which 지킴. 70점.

안적음.답: We watched the movie at the theater where there were many young couples.
안적음.까닭: 이 문항이 가르치는 전치사 + 관계대명사(in which)를 관계부사 where 로 피함 — 70점이면 됨.

안적음.답: We watched that movie at the theater in which there were many young couples.
안적음.까닭: '그 N' → that N 70점 — 소유자 결정.

시험.답: Show me one thing without which nothing could survive.
Show me one thing without which nothing can survive.
Please show me one thing without which nothing could survive.
Show me the one thing without which nothing could survive.

막힘.답: Show me one thing without which nothing can survive.
막힘.까닭: 한국어 '생존할 수 없는' 의 곧은 번역 can — 이 문항이 가르치는 without which 지킴 · 뜻 같음. 70점.

안적음.답: Please show me one thing without which nothing could survive.
안적음.까닭: 한국어 '보여 달라' 는 높임 없는 명령 — please 는 한국어에 없는 말을 더함, 70점이면 됨.

안적음.답: Show me the one thing without which nothing could survive.
안적음.까닭: 기능어 the 하나 더 — 소유자 결정 2 로 70점.

시험.답: He studies English.
He is studying English.

안적음.답: He is studying English.
안적음.까닭: 이 과 #7~18 은 시제 표 — 현재(#7)와 현재진행(#10 '공부하고 있다')을 가름. 진행형 대체 답안은 소유자 결정 4(12문항).

시험.답: I studied English.
I have studied English.

안적음.답: I have studied English.
안적음.까닭: 시제 표 — 과거(#8)와 현재완료(#15)를 가름 · 소유자 결정 4 ②(현재완료는 그대로).

시험.답: I will study English.
I'll study English.
I am going to study English.

안적음.답: I am going to study English.
안적음.까닭: 시제 표의 미래는 will — 괄호 '(하겠다)' 가 will 의 의지를 가리킴; be going to 는 이 표에 없는 꼴.

시험.답: I am studying English.
I'm studying English.
I was studying English.
I had been studying English.

안적음.답: I had been studying English.
안적음.까닭: 다른 시제 — 과거완료진행(#17 '공부해오고 있었다').

시험.답: I will be studying English.
I'll be studying English.
I am going to be studying English.

안적음.답: I am going to be studying English.
안적음.까닭: 시제 표의 미래진행은 will be -ing — be going to be -ing 는 이 표에 없는 꼴.

시험.답: I have studied English once.
I've studied English once.
I once studied English.
I have studied English before.

막힘.답: I have studied English before.
막힘.까닭: '…한 적이 있다'(경험) → have studied … before(경험의 현재완료에 가장 흔한 꼴) — 현재완료 지킴 · 뜻 같음. once ↔ before 가 달라 0점. '한때' 는 once 가 더 곧아 확신 보통.

안적음.답: I once studied English.
안적음.까닭: 이 문항이 가르치는 현재완료(경험)를 과거로 피함.

시험.답: I have studied English for ten years.
I've studied English for 10 years.
I have been studying English for ten years.

안적음.답: I have been studying English for ten years.
안적음.까닭: 이 과는 '-해왔다'(#14 have studied)와 '-해오고 있다'(#16 have been studying)를 가름 — 현재완료진행은 다른 칸.

시험.답: I have studied English.
I've studied English.
I have been studying English.

안적음.답: I have been studying English.
안적음.까닭: 시제 표 — 현재완료진행은 #16 '공부해오고 있다' 의 꼴.

시험.답: I have been studying English.
I've been studying English.
I had been studying English.
I'd been studying English.
I had studied English.
I'd studied English.
I studied English.
I used to study English.

안적음.답: I studied English.
안적음.까닭: 시제 표 — '-했었다' 는 과거완료(#18), 과거(#8 '공부했다')와 가름 — 70점이면 됨.

안적음.답: I used to study English.
안적음.까닭: 다른 꼴(과거 습관) — 시제 표의 과거완료를 피함.
